ruleName: Ball Played as It Lies; Ball on Putting Green
group: Rules: Ball on the Putting Green
title: Accidentally Moving a Ball on the Putting Green
question: Charlotte misses a short putt. While tapping down a spike mark, she accidentally causes her ball to move. She picks the ball up without first marking its position so that she can replace it. What is the ruling?

choices.text: Charlotte receives a one-stroke penalty for lifting the ball without marking it.
There is no penalty, provided the ball is replaced on its original spot.

explanation: There is no penalty for accidentally moving a ball on the putting green, provided the ball is replaced on its original spot. The player may lift the ball even if it was not first marked, but must replace it.
